hashDefinition: Hashes are keccak256 over decoded raw bytecode bytes excluding the 0x prefix; creation bytecode excludes constructor arguments.

governance.updatePolicy: Only an intentional contract change may update artifact identity. Record the old and new creation and deployed runtime-template hashes plus a specific reason in the contract-changing commit or governed change record. Regeneration merely to silence the guard is forbidden.

lastContractChange.reason: Make AGENT_STAKE a bounded constructor immutable so verification uses 10 USDC while production retains 100 USDC

independentExpectedComparison: not carried forward: this governed intentional contract change has no independent expected identity

deploymentAttestation.strategy: manifest-governed creation input and immutable-aware exact runtime reconstruction
deploymentAttestation.requirements: Map every compiler immutableReference AST ID to a name dynamically; require exactly one explicit manifest rule per name; verify the creation transaction input against governed creation bytecode plus manifest constructor arguments; require getters to equal manifest effective config; reconstruct runtime from manifest expectations; and require byte-for-byte equality, exact decoded length, and keccak256. SLASH_SINK resolves to the deployed address. Unknown, unmapped, missing, or duplicate rules reject the address.

arcRpcOpcodeProbes.scopeCaveat: Arc Testnet chainId 0x4cef52 only, limited to the recorded block and observed client. eth_call stateOverride measures the node EVM specification at that block. Later forks or client changes may alter behavior; Arc mainnet requires fresh probes.
arcRpcOpcodeProbes.interpretation: Read-only eth_call stateOverride probes succeeded at the pinned block; no transaction, deployment, or funds were used.
